title: Backend fails to boot: self-import of PlanDB in plan.py causes ImportError
description: backend/app/api/models/plan.py:6 executes `from app.api.models.plan import PlanDB` from within plan.py itself, before the PlanDB class (line 9) is defined. Python's import machinery reuses the partially initialized module from sys.modules; getattr for PlanDB fails. Verified on the live tree: `import app.api.routes.plans` raises `ImportError: cannot import name 'PlanDB' from partially initialized module 'app.api.models.plan'`. main.py imports app.api.routes.plans unconditionally (main.py:3), so the entire FastAPI application - every router, /health, startup DB init - fails to start. Introduced by commit feb5207d ('Update plan and plans modules with necessary imports and adjustments'), the only fix commit in repository history. Recorded in workspace/historical_learnings.jsonl.
impact: Total service availability loss: backend cannot boot or be deployed; all API endpoints unreachable.
mitigation: Delete line 6 (`from app.api.models.plan import PlanDB`) from plan.py; the name is available in the same module. Add a startup smoke test (`import app.api.routes.plans` / uvicorn boot check) to CI.
